import trimesh, numpy as np
# load instances from checks
box = trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.d40d2008.stl')
lid = trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.80ac5204.stl')
print("box bounds", box.bounds)
print("lid bounds", lid.bounds)
# sample lid bottom face triangles (normal -z)
# get faces with normal ~ [0,0,-1]
n = lid.face_normals
c = lid.triangles_center
mask = (np.abs(n[:,2]+1)<0.01)
print("lid bottom faces", mask.sum(), "area", lid.area_faces[mask].sum())
pts = c[mask]
print("x range", pts[:,0].min(), pts[:,0].max(), "y range", pts[:,1].min(), pts[:,1].max())
# box top faces at z=30 (normals +z)
nb = box.face_normals; cb = box.triangles_center
# triangles near z=30 top
maskb = (np.abs(nb[:,2]-1)<0.01) & (np.abs(cb[:,2]-30.0)<0.01)
print("box top faces", maskb.sum(), "area", box.area_faces[maskb].sum())
print("box tops bounds", cb[maskb].min(0) if maskb.sum() else None, cb[maskb].max(0) if maskb.sum() else None)
# for a few sample points on lid bottom (centers of bays), compute horizontal distance to nearest box top triangle center
# take grid of points
xs = np.linspace(-37,37,15); ys = np.linspace(-24,24,11)
xx,yy = np.meshgrid(xs,ys)
q = np.stack([xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()],axis=1)
# box top support points: use vertices of box at z=30
verts = box.vertices[(np.abs(box.vertices[:,2]-30.0)<0.01)]
print("num verts at z30", len(verts))
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
tree = cKDTree(verts[:,:2])
d,_ = tree.query(q)
print("max horizontal dist to z30 support:", d.max(), "mean", d.mean())
print("fraction >5mm:", (d>5).mean(), "count", (d>5).sum(), "/", len(d))
# show worst points
worst = q[np.argsort(d)[-10:]]
print("worst pts", worst, d[np.argsort(d)[-10:]])
